summary: Implemented the engine-free feature. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver with save, save_batch, finalize, overwrite merge rule, filename assertion); new monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver with save, save_batch, static _create_file_basename, dtype None keeps data dtype); nifti_writer.py default dtype changed to np.float32; monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py gained plot_2d_or_3d_image; segmentation_saver.py, classification_saver.py and tensorboard_handlers.py are now thin adapters over the savers and plot function (classification registers an engine-accepting finalize wrapper); callers updated from output_path to output_dir in two examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py; tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py passes filename. New tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Verification was by reading only: no tests run, no flake8 run. Static checks found no lines over 120 characters, no trailing whitespace, no blank final lines, and no remaining output_path references. Nothing is committed.
